-- ---------- feed RPC (keyset, 20/page default) ----------
-- returns originals + reposts in one reverse-chron stream
create or replace function clqfm_feed(viewer uuid, tab text, before_ts timestamptz, before_id text, lim int)
returns table (
  entry_id text, is_repost boolean, sort_ts timestamptz, sort_key text,
  post_id text, author_id uuid, body varchar(500), kind text, media text[],
  parent_id text, created_at timestamptz, like_count int, repost_count int, reply_count int,
  author_handle text, author_name text, author_avatar text,
  liked boolean, reposted boolean,
  reposted_by uuid, reposted_by_name text, reposted_by_handle text, reposted_at timestamptz
) language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  with scope as (
    select f.followee_id as who from clqfm_follows f where f.follower_id = viewer
    union select viewer
  ),
  orig as (
    select ('p:'||p.id)::text entry_id, false is_repost, p.created_at sort_ts,
      ('p:'||p.id) sort_key, p.id post_id, p.author_id, p.body, p.kind, p.media,
      p.parent_id, p.created_at, p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count,
      null::uuid reposted_by, null::timestamptz reposted_at
    from clqfm_posts p
    where p.parent_id is null
      and (tab = 'global' or p.author_id in (select who from scope))
  ),
  repo as (
    select ('r:'||r.user_id::text||':'||r.post_id)::text entry_id, true is_repost, r.created_at sort_ts,
      ('r:'||r.user_id::text||':'||r.post_id) sort_key, p.id post_id, p.author_id, p.body, p.kind, p.media,
      p.parent_id, p.created_at, p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count,
      r.user_id reposted_by, r.created_at reposted_at
    from clqfm_reposts r join clqfm_posts p on p.id = r.post_id
    where p.parent_id is null
      and (tab = 'global' or r.user_id in (select who from scope))
  ),
  -- Contract: an original and each qualifying repost surface as SEPARATE
  -- cards (repost-toggle-live-attribution requires the count to grow; the
  -- follow-edge projection requires a direct card alongside a viewer repost).
  stream as (select * from orig union all select * from repo)
  select s.entry_id, s.is_repost, s.sort_ts, s.sort_key,
    s.post_id, s.author_id, s.body, s.kind, s.media, s.parent_id, s.created_at,
    s.like_count, s.repost_count, s.reply_count,
    ap.handle author_handle, ap.display_name author_name, ap.avatar_path author_avatar,
    exists (select 1 from clqfm_likes l where l.post_id = s.post_id and l.user_id = viewer) liked,
    exists (select 1 from clqfm_reposts rr where rr.post_id = s.post_id and rr.user_id = viewer) reposted,
    s.reposted_by,
    rp.display_name reposted_by_name, rp.handle reposted_by_handle, s.reposted_at
  from stream s
  join clqfm_profiles ap on ap.user_id = s.author_id
  left join clqfm_profiles rp on rp.user_id = s.reposted_by
  where (before_ts is null or s.sort_ts < before_ts
      or (s.sort_ts = before_ts and s.sort_key < before_id))
  order by s.sort_ts desc, s.sort_key desc
  limit lim;
$$

create function clqfm_history(viewer uuid, convo text, before_ts timestamptz, before_id text, lim int)
returns table (
  id text, conversation_id text, sender_id uuid, kind text, body text,
  media_path text, view_once boolean, quote_id text, edited boolean,
  deleted boolean, expires_at timestamptz, purged boolean,
  created_at timestamptz, sender_handle text, sender_name text,
  sender_avatar text, quote_body text, quote_sender_name text,
  reactions jsonb, my_reaction text, receipt text, viewed boolean
) language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if not clqfm_ever_member(convo, viewer) then
    raise exception 'CLQFM_NOT_A_MEMBER';
  end if;
  return query
  select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.kind,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.body end,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.media_path end,
    m.view_once, m.quote_id, m.edited, m.deleted, m.expires_at, m.purged, m.created_at,
    sp.handle, sp.display_name::text, sp.avatar_path,
    (case when qm.deleted then '' else qm.body end), qp.display_name::text,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('emoji', g.emoji, 'count', g.cnt,
        'mine', exists (select 1 from clqfm_reactions r2
          where r2.message_id = m.id and r2.user_id = viewer and r2.emoji = g.emoji)))
      from (select r.emoji, count(*) cnt from clqfm_reactions r
            where r.message_id = m.id group by r.emoji) g), '[]'::jsonb),
    (select r.emoji from clqfm_reactions r where r.message_id = m.id and r.user_id = viewer limit 1),

create function clqfm_history(viewer uuid, convo text, before_ts timestamptz, before_id text, lim int)
returns table (
  id text, conversation_id text, sender_id uuid, kind text, body text,
  media_path text, view_once boolean, quote_id text, edited boolean,
  deleted boolean, expires_at timestamptz, purged boolean,
  created_at timestamptz, sender_handle text, sender_name text,
  sender_avatar text, quote_body text, quote_sender_name text,
  reactions jsonb, my_reaction text, receipt text, viewed boolean,
  poll jsonb
) language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if not clqfm_ever_member(convo, viewer) then
    raise exception 'CLQFM_NOT_A_MEMBER';
  end if;
  return query
  select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.kind,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.body end,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.media_path end,
    m.view_once, m.quote_id, m.edited, m.deleted, m.expires_at, m.purged, m.created_at,
    sp.handle, sp.display_name::text, sp.avatar_path,
    (case when qm.deleted then '' else qm.body end), qp.display_name::text,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('emoji', g.emoji, 'count', g.cnt,
        'mine', exists (select 1 from clqfm_reactions r2
          where r2.message_id = m.id and r2.user_id = viewer and r2.emoji = g.emoji)))
      from (select r.emoji, count(*) cnt from clqfm_reactions r
            where r.message_id = m.id group by r.emoji) g), '[]'::jsonb),
    (select r.emoji from clqfm_reactions r where r.message_id = m.id and r.user_id = viewer limit 1),
    (select case when count(*) = 0 then 'sent'
      when bool_and(r.state = 'read') then 'read'
      when bool_and(r.state in ('delivered','read')) then 'delivered'
      else 'sent' end
     from clqfm_receipts r where r.message_id = m.id),
    exists (select 1 from clqfm_viewonce_views v
      where v.message_id = m.id and v.user_id = viewer),
    case when m.kind = 'poll' then clqfm_poll_state(viewer, m.id) else null end
  from clqfm_messages m
  join clqfm_profiles sp on sp.user_id = m.sender_id
  left join clqfm_messages qm on qm.id = m.quote_id
  left join clqfm_profiles qp on qp.user_id = qm.sender_id
  where m.conversation_id = convo and not m.purged
    and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
    and (before_ts is null or m.created_at < before_ts
      or (m.created_at = before_ts and m.id < before_id))
  order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc
  limit lim;
end $$
